summary: Display Billing Payment Status Without Blocking Access to Clinical Forms
description:
Display overall patient payment status prominently on the patient banner without blocking access to clinical forms or interrupting care delivery.
User Story: 
As a healthcare provider (triage nurse, clinician, lab technician, or pharmacist), I want to see the patient's payment status prominently displayed in the patient chart so I can make informed decisions about care sequencing while maintaining clinical continuity without delays in care delivery.

Functional Requirements: 
Payment status states:
Paid: Full payment received → Green badge

Partially Paid: Some payment pending → Yellow badge

Unpaid: No payment received → Red badge


Non-blocking behaviour ~ Payment status is informational only
Payment status is informational only – does not prevent clinical actions

Clinical forms remain fully accessible regardless of payment status

Providers retain full access to: patient records (clinical forms, labs, medications)

No blocking modal dialogs or pop-ups interrupts clinical workflow
